faqMessage:
💬 *FAQ & PAYMENT INFO — {{storeUpper}}*

*1. What payment methods are accepted?*
You can pay via *QRIS*! Supports all Indonesian e-wallets (GoPay, OVO, DANA, ShopeePay) & Mobile Banking (BCA, Mandiri, BRI, BNI, etc.) 📱

*2. Why is there a 3-digit unique code in the total?*
The 3-digit code allows our system to *automatically verify your payment in seconds* without uploading transfer receipts! Please transfer the exact amount including the last 3 digits ✨

*3. How is the item delivered?*
Items are gifted 100% officially via *The Hive In-Game Gift* feature directly to your Minecraft Bedrock Gamertag 🎁

*4. How long does delivery take?*
Once payment is detected, our bot delivers your gift within *1 - 3 minutes* ⚡

Any questions? Feel free to contact our store admin team in the group 😊
